instruction: Tighten this document: cut redundancy, shorten long sentences, and make the prose crisper throughout.
edited_document:
# Sample project review — first stage

<!-- lark:block:l01 -->
## Summary

<!-- lark:block:l02 -->
The reader work landed on time and is now consumed by two consumer projects.

<!-- lark:block:l03 -->
The remaining risk is in the writer surface: the plan-gated apply engine still refuses shapes consumers ask for regularly.

<!-- lark:block:l04 -->
## Reliability

<!-- lark:block:l05 -->
Three failed test runs outside any release all traced to a missing field-level permission scope.

<!-- lark:block:l06 -->
Follow-up work made failures legible rather than widening scopes—a grant is a console action, not a library decision.

<!-- lark:block:l07 -->
## Throughput

<!-- lark:block:l08 -->
Scripting board moves eliminated drift between folder state and logs.

<!-- lark:block:l09 -->
Review latency on large tranches remains, with a single reviewer holding too much context.

<!-- lark:block:l10 -->
## Consumers

<!-- lark:block:l11 -->
The reference consumer pins the library locally and refreshes only when it chooses.

<!-- lark:block:l12 -->
This is good: no surprise ships, and refresh is where compatibility is checked.

<!-- lark:block:l13 -->
## Resources

<!-- lark:block:l14 -->
Disk use was flat; the only new space went to a small sandbox for live write gates, torn down after each run.

<!-- lark:block:l15 -->
One avoidable cost: a week of rework from misdiagnosis.

<!-- lark:block:l16 -->
## Second stage

<!-- lark:block:l17 -->
The second stage centers on round-trip editing—the most-requested capability the library currently lacks.

<!-- lark:block:l18 -->
Everything else follows, since a half-built round-trip is worse than none.

<!-- lark:block:l19 -->
### Risks

<!-- lark:block:l20 -->
- Review latency on large tranches
- A single reviewer holding all the context
- The round-trip work slipping into the following stage

<!-- lark:block:l21 -->
Risks are ordered by likelihood, not discomfort.

<!-- lark:block:l22 -->
### Numbers

<!-- lark:block:l23 -->
| Metric | Stage 1 | Target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Failed runs | 3 | 0 |
| Median cycle time | 4.1 days | 3 days |
| Consumer refreshes | 6 | 6 |

<!-- lark:block:l24 -->
Cycle time excludes two issues parked for the maintainer decisions; holding time ≠ review time.

<!-- lark:block:l25 -->
### Decisions needed

<!-- lark:block:l26 -->
Decide whether round-trip ships behind a flag or as default—this gates all sequencing after it.
